title: Judge the Tuned Model
briefMd:
# Judge the Tuned Model

Same frozen 40-ticket set. No live model calls — the playground scores two **already-recorded** eval traces:

| Model | Setup | Headline |
|---|---|---|
| **Base** `bare` | no adapter · seed 1 | **28/40 (70.0%)** |
| **LoRA-tuned** `fewshot` | adapter v3 · seed 2 | **31/40 (77.5%)** |

The tuned model looks like a +7.5 pp win. At grade time we recompute accuracy and **95% Wilson intervals** on the frozen predictions.

Pass when you call the delta **noise**, not a tuning win, and you name **CI overlap** or **seed/wrapper** — not “the tuned model is better”.

rankingCall.description: Is the headline accuracy delta a real tuning win?
